description: Construction of a single storey outbuilding to provide ancillary residential accommodation to main dwellinghouse.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the residential occupation of 101 Forest Road by its occupiers and their guests. It shall not be occupied as any person’s sole or main residence, or let or occupied as separate residential accommodation.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains ancillary to the host dwelling and does not become an independent unit of accommodation without assessment of its planning impacts, in accordance with Policies 53 and 57 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan (2024).

The development hereby permitted shall be constructed entirely of the materials details shown on plan No. [INSERT - XX ] /in accordance with the approved materials schedule [INSERT - XX] unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

No oven, hob or other appliance for cooking meals, whether fixed or portable, shall be installed or kept within the outbuilding. The sink and refreshment area shown on approved drawing 031-SLD-DR-A-101 P04 shall be retained solely for the preparation of drinks and light refreshments.Reason: To maintain the functional dependence of the outbuilding on the host dwelling, consistent with its approved ancillary use.
